verified_facts.text: Cosme is a beachfront resort in the village of Naoussa on Paros, with the Aegean at its feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the soulful village of Naousa —the jewel of Paros— with the clear-blue Aegean water at its feet, beachfront Cosme embraces the energy of the sea

verified_facts.text: The center of Naoussa town is about a 10-minute walk along the coast from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the center of Naoussa itself—a soulful town with a cosmopolitan spirit yet the humble soul of a traditional fishing village—just a 10-minute walk that weaves along the coast

verified_facts.text: The architecture is by ID Laboratorium and reflects the shapes of the surroundings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The architecture by ID Laboratorium reflects the shapes of the surroundings

verified_facts.text: All buildings are clean-lined and made with local stone, inspired by the island's fishing villages and indigenous houses.
verified_facts.excerpt: all buildings are clean-lined and made with local stone showcasing harmonious architectural compositions inspired by the island’s bright fishing villages and indigenous houses

verified_facts.text: Meandering pathways through the property create an intimate village-style feel.
verified_facts.excerpt: meandering pathways throughout the property create an intimate village-style feel

verified_facts.text: The infinity pool is shaped like a half-moon, mirroring the bay of Naoussa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cosme’s iconic infinity pool is designed in a half-moon shape, mirroring the bay of Naoussa, where Cosme stands.

verified_facts.text: From the pool, guests look toward the harbor town, the sea and the small fishing port with its traditional caiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests relaxing by the pool appreciate panoramic views towards the harbor town, the sea and the small fishing port with the traditional caiques

verified_facts.text: The suites blend traditional textures and local stone with curated decoration and have terraces shaded by wicker pergolas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Balancing the traditional textures and local stone with carefully curated decoration, the suites of Cosme envelope guests in a luxurious narrative of Paros. Complete with terraces shaded by wicker pergolas,

verified_facts.text: The Cosmos Suite is the resort's top suite category, on the ground floor with Aegean Sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: is the resort's top suite category. Located on the ground floor with spectacular views to the Aegean Sea

verified_facts.text: The Cosmos Suite terrace has its own private plunge pool, sunbeds and an open-air dining area.
verified_facts.excerpt: The expansive terrace is endowed with its own private plunge pool, sunbeds and an open-air dining area

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Suite looks out to Cosme's private beach and the Aegean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ocean Suite, as its name implies, boasts views to the private beach of Cosme and the Aegean Sea.

verified_facts.text: Interiors use warm shades such as olive green, deep burgundy, red and blue alongside traditional Cycladic white.
verified_facts.excerpt: Intense warm shades, such as olive green, deep burgundy, red and blue complement the traditional white that is synonymous with the Cycladic islands.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's art centers on three themes: naval tradition, folklife and Mediterranean summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: The artwork selection is centered around three different themes; naval tradition, folklife and Mediterranean summer.

verified_facts.text: The leading artist is Margarita Myrogianni, whose pieces draw on fishermen's nets, sea urchin shapes, nautical ropes and Cycladic light.
verified_facts.excerpt: The leading artist at Cosme is Margarita Myrogianni who through her 12 different pieces spread around the resort, draws inspiration from local fishermen’s nets, sea urchin shapes, nautical ropes and the light of the Cycladic islands.

verified_facts.text: Cosme has a private Beach Club with seaside loungers, cocktails and snacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cosme’s private Beach Club is the perfect location to dip toes into the pristine Aegean waters, whilst enjoying cocktails, snacks and more on the seaside loungers

verified_facts.text: Elios Spa has two treatment rooms and a relaxation area with an indoor jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring two treatment rooms and a relaxation area with indoor jacuzzi, Elios Spa is an oasis

verified_facts.text: Elios Spa offers signature treatments and rituals tailored to individual needs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a personalized wellness journey that embraces the slow-paced Cycladic way of life with signature treatments and rituals tailored to individual needs.

verified_facts.text: A stargazing platform at the resort's highest point has 360-degree views of Naoussa, the sea and the mountains of Paros.
verified_facts.excerpt: The stargazing platform is located at the highest point of the resort. Standing there, guests enjoy 360 views of Naoussa, the sea as well as the mountainous side of Paros.

verified_facts.text: The Fitness Hall has Technogym equipment and is built with local Parian stone and wood, with natural light through the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fitness Hall features state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and is built with local Parian stone and wood, allowing natural light to come in throughout the day.

verified_facts.text: Greek chef Yiannis Kioroglou leads the dining, having joined from La Petite Maison in Cannes and La Guerite in Saint Barth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Having joined Cosme from La Petite Maison in Cannes and La Guerite in Saint Barth

verified_facts.text: Parostia restaurant sits on the beachfront and takes its name from the stone oven of traditional Parian houses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parostia sits right on the beachfront and takes its name from the stone oven of traditional Parian houses.

verified_facts.text: Circe Bar is beside the half-moon pool, with a lounge that has sunset views over the bay of Naoussa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Circe Bar is adjacent to the half-moon pool and a few steps away from Parostià Restaurant. A beautiful lounge crowns the bar with sensational sunset views over the bay of Naoussa.

verified_facts.text: Cosme takes its name from the Greek word cosmos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cosme takes its name from the Greek word "cosmos,"

verified_facts.text: The Empiria Lounge, a guest rest point run by the hotel group, sits in Parikia, steps from the Paros port.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Empiria Lounge sits at the heart of Parikia, just steps away from Paros’ port.

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms and babysitting services are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connecting rooms are available (as are babysitting services)

verified_facts.text: Tours of local towns, wine tastings, farm visits and boat trips can be arranged through the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tours of local towns, wine tastings, farm visits, and boat trips can all be arranged through the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel has no accessible rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: No Accessible Rooms Available at this Hotel

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at Cosme, a Luxury Collection Resort, Paros.
